http://www.euronews.com/2026/08/28/numbe.text: The number of people missing in Nepal and China surpassed 2,400 on Friday, underscoring the scale of the disaster days after a tsunami-like wall of water and debris swept away villages and killed hundreds.Rescuers were battling through mud even as the threat of new floods loomed, with emergency teams recovering 586 bodies so far and some of the dead swept downstream as far away as India.The new figures came as Nepal's disaster authority added 933 hydropower workers to a missing persons list already including trekkers and pilgrims to Tibet's sacred Mount Kailash.Relatives have crowded hospitals in Nepal's capital in a painful hunt for their loved ones, with posters on the walls bearing photos and names of the missing."Today is the third day and we don't know anything. Hopefully he is in a safe place," Samjhana Thing, 27, told the AFP news agency referring to her brother. "We lost everything. He is our everything."The US Geological Survey said the disaster, the deadliest for Nepal since a 2015 earthquake, was caused by a glacial collapse that triggered a vast flow of icy debris.The deluge of ice and mud also caused huge lakes to form and one of these formations has become a direct threat to emergency workers scouring the region for survivors.Nepali police urged all rescuers to "immediately move to a safe location", saying it had received information that "a water dam has burst again on the Tibetan side."In Tibet, China was forced to suspend its rescue operation at the hardest-hit area of Gyirong over the risk of renewed flooding on Friday, before saying the threat had eased.State broadcaster CCTV reported that a lake formed by immense piles of debris began overflowing toward where rescue teams were headed, but later said the water level of the pool had dropped.Rescue operations were therefore "proceeding in an orderly manner", it added.Chinese President Xi Jinping, who chaired a meeting on rescue efforts, offered Beijing's help to Nepal's emergency operations.Swept awayEmergency teams had been racing to retrieve survivors from affected zones, where the widespread devastation meant food and water supplies were running out.The Nepali military located people trapped in the tunnel of Trishuli 3A hydropower project, where they were working to find a way in to extract the survivors."Two helicopters have been dispatched but it is challenging because it is tough to even locate the entry points of the tunnel," army spokesman Raja Ram Basnet told AFP.Some 350 workers and residents have been brought to safety from the site, he added, but efforts were ongoing to rescue more than 100 people trapped in the same area.Workers rescued from other dam projects along the Trishuli valley described a disaster that unfolded with terrifying speed.Buddha Tamang told AFP he survived only because he was inside a tunnel at the dam where he worked when the flood struck."The senior officers working on the other side, they were all swept away," Tamang, who was airlifted on Thursday after being marooned for more than 24 hours, said.Aid trickles inAid began to reach some survivors in Nepal on Friday, as the full scope of the devastation continued to emerge and survivors sought shelter at makeshift army relief centres.Children who have been separated from their families are being given shelter as attempts are made to reunite them with families.The UN's agency for children UNICEF said at least 17,000 children are in urgent need of humanitarian assistance, while 18 schools have been destroyed and another 20 damaged.The International Red Cross estimates that at least 93,000 people have been affected and are in “great need.”Also on Friday, the European Union promised €2 million in aid for Nepal with European Commission chief Ursula von der Leyen writing on X that the "immediate humanitarian aid" would help "deliver life-saving assistance to families and communities hit hardest."

StaceviÄius / LRT A family of four needs at least â¬3,500 a month in take-home pay to live comfortably â covering a mortgage, everyday costs and two foreign holidays a year â according to a Lithuanian personal finance expert.Â The finding is a useful benchmark for a country where the average net wage is just over â¬1,500 a month, roughly in line with the EU average but well below western European levels. The figure comes from Sigita StrockytÄ-VarnÄ, who advises individuals and families on personal finances. She puts the comfortable range at â¬3,500 to â¬4,500, though she's quick to add that the number shifts depending on how many cars a family runs, what schools or nurseries the children attend, whether there's a mortgage â and how much, if anything, the family wants to save. Sigita StrockytÄ-VarnÄ | Personal archive The gap between the average wage and that comfort threshold is stark: a family of four with two adults each earning the average would bring home around â¬3,000 combined â workable, StrockytÄ-VarnÄ says, but tight, and likely to involve trade-offs. A manageable mortgage might run to â¬600â700 a month, but that would mean limiting foreign holidays to once a year, owning rather than financing a car, and keeping social spending modest. Single parents, she adds, face the hardest situation of all. Parents and kids | Pixabay.com Earning more doesn't always mean living better The more striking part of her argument is that income, on its own, is a poor guide to financial comfort. "Your salary doesn't tell you what you can afford. I've seen plenty of clients earning above the average wage and living paycheque to paycheque â that happens because of poor financial management. Sometimes as income rises, spending rises even faster." She describes a pattern she sees repeatedly: as earnings grow, so do expectations. The economy car stops feeling adequate. Cooking at home feels less appealing. Small luxuries quietly become defaults. "We start wanting better things... the thinking becomes â I can afford this." At the extreme end, she notes, some households in Vilnius â the capital, where costs are somewhat higher â feel that â¬7,000 a month isn't enough. But that, she says, reflects a completely different kind of life: eating out as a matter of routine, employing household help, rarely if ever cooking at home. Budgeting | J. StaceviÄius / LRT So what actually makes the difference? StrockytÄ-VarnÄ points to a handful of habits that tend to separate those who feel financially comfortable from those who don't, regardless of what they earn: cooking at home regularly, not treating clothing or possessions as a constant priority, and, critically, being deliberate about what you're actually saving towards. For a single person with no major financial commitments, she says, even the average Lithuanian wage of â¬1,500 net can be enough not just to get by, but to save. The challenge, as she sees it, isn't usually the income â it's whether spending is being managed with any intention at all. LRT English Newsletter Every Friday morning. Thanks for subscribing! https://hvg.hu/tudomany/20261109_gta-6-j.text: A Rockstar Games felülmúlta önmagát: a GTA 5-höz és a Red Dead Redemption 2-höz mérten is több jutalmat lehet majd megszerezni a GTA 6-ban. Tíz nap van hátra a GTA-rajongók legjobban várt napjáig, a tervek szerint ugyanis november 19-én mutatja majd be a sorozat legújabb részét, a GTA 6-ot. A játék kapcsán számos részlet derült már ki, például az, hogy milyen zenék lesznek benne , egy 26 perces videóban pedig gyakorlatilag a teljes látványvilág láthatóvá vált. Most egy újabb apróság derült ki a játékról. Nevezetesen: a játékmenet során összesen 55 trófea/jutalom lesz megszerezhető. Az információ a TexFunz2 nevű felhasználótól származik, aki arról ismert, hogy a Rockstar játékaiból minden lehetséges érdekes információt kikutat. Az erről szóló bejegyzését ugyan törölte az X-ről, az iGrandTheftAuto azonban újra megosztotta azt. Ez utóbbit szúrta ki az Eurogamer is. GTA 6 currently has 55 achievements configured. Interestingly, 54 use values between 1 and 54, while another is assigned 1000. That 1000-point achievement could be for completing the entire set, or it may be a placeholder for an Xbox Mythic achievement. via @TexFunz2 pic.twitter.com/GAFWRVRX4d Jelenleg még nem tudni pontosan, milyen kihívásokat kell teljesíteni, de úgy tűnik, egyik sem kapcsolódik a játék online változatához. Mivel az alapjáték GTA Online nélkül jelenik meg, lényegében biztosra vehető, hogy ezek a jutalmak kizárólag az egyjátékos módhoz tartoznak. A Twitch vezérigazgatója szerint a GTA Online valamikor 2027-ben érkezik majd, vagyis akkortól kezdve lehet majd játszani a játékkal a neten keresztül, több felhasználóval egyszerre. Érdekesség, hogy a GTA 5-ben 51 jutalmat lehetett bezsebelni, míg a Red Dead Redemption 2-ben 52-t, így a GTA 6 ezeket már biztosan túlszárnyalja. Érdemes persze azt is megjegyezni, hogy miután a GTA 5 online is játszhatóvá vált, a jutalmak száma 78-ra emelkedett, így valószínűleg a GTA 6 esetében sem lesz ez másként. Ha máskor is tudni szeretne hasonló dolgokról, lájkolja a HVG Tech rovatának Facebook-oldalát .
